name: cincy-rocks
description: Festival guide for bands, schedule and venues, with admin band approval and invite codes. Web, Android and iOS.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:emulator: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:simulator: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
